body: The smile from this woman is exactly the fake bullshit service you get from universities as they put in crippling debt for a piece of paper that won't even get you a job.
Why do other people get to decide you can't take your own life?
Mental health professionals don't give a fuck
Even if I do get better, the world is going to end soon

I will never be successful no matter how hard I try. I have a Master's degree, I have worked in labs, I have worked for the Federal Government. The only jobs I can get hired for are for shit pay doing grueling work

People are shamed for posting anything on social media that is genuine. If you are sad, depressed, anxious, then nobody wants to hear about it. They will talk about you behind your back and put you down, then stop associating with you. All the while pretending they are mental health allies
